checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the prices.

The includesText lists arrangements conference, planning, family and clergy consultation, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory and third parties plus overhead.
No other mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears; only Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead is described as added to arrangements.
No D-embalming disclosure is present in the disclosures array, so the placement test does not apply.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered with a purchaser-provided container option and no text says a casket is required for direct cremation.
The direct cremation includesText mentions transportation to crematory and cremation, and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is listed to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no goods or services appear only inside a package or description.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are required items, not packages.
No text asserts a purchase is required by law, cemetery or crematory beyond the wording of the required disclosures themselves.
No claims about delaying decomposition or protecting the body from gravesite substances appear.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure; the unfilled '(specify containers)' blank alone is not a concern for this check.
